To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a predictive control scheme with iron powder inductance as filter element can provide an excellent current quality under adverse grid conditions.

a grid side converter with an iron powder inductor as a filter element has a high overload capability and that this overload capability can be used to improve the fault ride through capability of the converter.
a predictive control scheme can be used to achieve a robust grid side inverter operation under adverse grid conditions with enhanced overload capabilities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an active power filter (APF) for power quality improvement.
the development of new control strategies for the grid side inverter of a wind turbine.
the design of a grid side inverter control strategy that allows for a robust operation under grid faults with enhanced overload capability of the power converter.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed control scheme shows excellent performance for grid current injection into three-phase grids.
the proposed control scheme is a promising candidate for future grid connected power converters.
the proposed control scheme is able to provide a high level of robustness against grid faults, which is a very important feature in the context of grid side inverters for renewable energy systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the control scheme is able to inject current into the grid with a high quality even under unsymmetrical grid fault conditions.
the proposed control scheme is able to achieve a robust grid connection of the inverter with a very high overload capacity and an excellent current quality.
the proposed control scheme is able to provide a robust grid side inverter control for grid side converters with a high overload capability.
The main takeaway from our work is that

by usage of iron powder filters and the proposed control scheme, a high overload capability of power converters for grid connected applications can be realized without increasing the converter rating and without the need for a complex control scheme.
the proposed control scheme is robust against grid disturbances, which makes it a suitable control scheme for grid side inverters.
the proposed control scheme is able to inject a high quality grid current into a three-phase grid under adverse grid conditions and with high overload capabilities.
